name: Thomas Andrus, carpenter

proprietors.name: Thomas Andrus
proprietors.basis: THE TRADE IS THE SOURCE'S; THE HOUSE IS THE INFERENCE. Thomas Andrus carries dated role(s) of `carpenter` that cover 1835-07-01, graded attested on rr_dupage_andrus_1882. That the trade was followed at Chicago in window is what the source says; that it was followed in a house of this keeper's own is this record's inference, and it is graded `inferred` for that reason and never promoted. The keeper held no workplace in the business layer before T-1404.

locations.basis: NO READING PLACES THIS HOUSE. The evidence is a trade on a card, not a printed address, so the record carries its limit rather than a guess.
locations.limit_reason: The source names the trade and not the premises. T-1198 seats every attested and inferred house on the ground its evidence allows — a structure where one is named, a lot where an address narrows it, a division band where only that is known — and this house waits there.

dates.basis: The role's bound is the SOURCE's span and not the house's: nothing says when this shop opened or closed. The record stands on the scene date because the role covers it, and bounds neither end.

proprietor_community.basis: The 1 keeper(s) this record names and the resident layer holds a card for all read british: Thomas Andrus (british). A house is not its keeper, so the reading is an inference about the house and is capped there.

replaceable_by: raised_for_an_in_window_trade: raised by tools/complete_inwindow_trades.py because the keeper's dated role covers 1835-07-01 and the layer held no workplace for them. Retired or rewritten by any printing that names this house — a notice, a directory line or a biography giving its style, its street or its partners — and by an identity ruling that makes this keeper one of the 52 printed keepers the register could not match to a card.
